The '''Miasmic Order of Ardos''' was an organization that had existed by the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. [[Voontara Fa'athra]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] claimed that he was the last member of the order.
